title: Week 4 of creating an Omni-Sandbox-Action-Brawler 3rd person.
author: thekojiverse
selftext: Started off with ALS Refactored 4.14 and slowly built my own MASON Locomotion system, I just need to create some animations that feel well.  ALS’s animations are placeholders. 6DoF gimbal lock is screwing with inverted flight and upside down movement. I will integrate combat soon as that’s the most important part I’d like to create.

comments.author: SeaThePirate
comments.body: is it crazy to say that bottom looks better

replies.author: thekojiverse
replies.body: not at all!! i love this opinion. i’ll keep the bottom as i’m already with that setting. i’m going to hardcode the Gimbal Lock to be more like Gravity Rush (Kat the Protagonist was able to gyrate here movement 360!! like a ball floating in the ocean with a crosshair)

replies.author: SeaThePirate
replies.body: im lowkey trying to make a game that i wish would have the vibe like the bottom, like even the placeholder animations per se. Sure they need some work but its definitely up my alley. Can you explain a bit more on how you made it work? I personally use ChatGPT + Blender and its a meant to be a demo in a browser game but im still curious

replies.author: thekojiverse
replies.body: I’ve been working on this without any Ai up until September 2nd. My ONLY usage is of instruction and guidance with 360 Rotation and 6DoF Gimble Lock and Speed mathetcial tweaks as I suck entirely at math!! I could not have gotten this far without my Solo Dev friend Benjamin and his Locomotion tips

replies.author: SeaThePirate
replies.body: ah hell i dont have a solo dev friend mathematician to rely on.

replies.author: thekojiverse
replies.body: i’ll definitely help you, dm me anytime brother we’re all trying to make the game we always wanted to play as kids. that’s my goal😭

comments.author: thekojiverse
comments.body: combat is something i’m testing right now. i like it but i want it to be more impactful, the ragdoll should be reacting to hit and be easy to juggle / escape from.

comments.author: jhnam88
comments.body: Very smooth moving, no plan to open it as OSS?

comments.author: thekojiverse
comments.body: i would love to open it as OSS, give me some time to perfect the 6DoF Gimbal Lock and Combat so it’s a bit more polished. Last night i upgraded movement with better animations and building a basic low poly city map.
